title: DIP draft contract v1
description: Setup proposal derived from Sprint 3. No endpoint is implemented. Firestore Timestamp values map to ISO 8601 UTC on JSON boundaries.

officeAddress.description: Street address of the office, as picked by an admin (setCompanyOfficeV1). Absent until set; officeLatitude/officeLongitude of 0/0 also mean not set.

officePlaceId.description: Google Places place ID of the office (setCompanyOfficeV1).

officeLocationAt.description: Server-owned: when officeLatitude/officeLongitude were last fetched from Google Places (refreshed within 30 days).

workLocation.description: Server-owned (admin tooling, roster, import). Office or site name, empty when unknown.

status.description: Server-owned. Missing means active. deactivated blocks sign-in access and company reads.

revision.description: Server-owned, optional. Incremented by every admin edit; used for optimistic concurrency.

statusUpdatedAt.description: Server-owned, optional. When status last changed.

locale.description: Server-owned, optional (setMyLocaleV1). Language of server-written copy (email, push) and the admin portal default. Missing means en. iOS keeps following the device language.

TagStat.description: companies/{companyId}/tagStats/{tagId}: server-owned count of counting members (companyId set, status not deactivated) whose interestTagIds hold the tag. Maintained by the onUserInterestsWritten trigger and corrected by the nightly reconcileTagStats job. Readable by organizers and admins of the company; never written by clients. memberCount can briefly go below zero after an out-of-order retry; display max(0, memberCount).

placeId.description: Google Places place ID the coordinates were resolved from. Present when the server resolved the location; the daily refresh job keeps coordinates within the 30-day caching limit and retires them (0/0) after the event ends.

updatedBy.description: Server-owned: UID of the organizer whose updateEventV1 wrote the current revision.

changeLog.description: Server-owned, optional: latest 50 user-visible changes, oldest first (onEventChanged trigger).

venueLocationAt.description: Server-owned: when venue latitude/longitude were last fetched from Google Places. Absent for manually entered or legacy coordinates.

by.description: Editor UID from Event.updatedBy, or "organizer" when the writer is unknown.

SetMyLocaleRequest.description: setMyLocaleV1: the signed-in member sets the language of their emails and pushes. The uid comes from Auth.

NotificationCategory.description: Notification category ids shared by push, email and the in-app center; registry in gcp/functions/src/modules/notifications/domain/categories.ts.

PushCategoryPreferences.description: Per-category push switches; a missing key means the server-side default.

EmailCategoryPreferences.description: Per-category email switches for the categories email offers (never chat or social); a missing key means the server-side default (off for reminders, discovery, admin_suggestions, weekly_themes and admin_digest).

weekly_themes.description: Weekly theme announcement email when a new weekly theme starts. Default off: only members who turned it on get it.

admin_digest.description: Daily roster digest for admins (invited people who joined, imports that finished). Default off; admins only.

NotificationPreferences.description: Stored at users/{uid}/settings/notifications. Owner writes the allow-listed keys directly; a missing document, map or key resolves to registry defaults server-side.

PushNotificationData.description: FCM data payload (all values strings). eventId is optional because challenge pushes (approved, changes requested, weekly theme) have no event; push delivery is flag-off and unshipped, so relaxing it is safe.

source.description: Server-owned, optional: who created the RSVP (missing means self).

managedBy.description: Server-owned, optional: uid of the admin who added or removed the attendee.

status.description: Server-owned. submitted = pending review (also after a resubmission), approved = points awarded, rejected = needs changes (the member may resubmit while the window is open).

storagePath.description: companies/{companyId}/challenges/{challengeId}/submissions/{userId}/{slot} with slot 0..4 (one create-only Storage object per slot), or null for a note-only submission.

contentType.description: Server-owned, optional: verified evidence content type.

sizeBytes.description: Server-owned, optional: verified evidence size in bytes.

attempt.description: Server-owned, optional: 1 for the first submission, +1 for every resubmission after a rejection.

reviewedBy.description: Server-owned: organizer uid of the last review, null while pending.

reviewNote.description: Server-owned: the organizer's reason for a rejection.

pointsAwarded.description: Server-owned: points credited on approval (0 until approved).

storagePath.description: companies/{companyId}/events/{eventId}/photos/{uploaderId}/{slot} with slot 0..19 (one create-only object per slot).

downloadURL.description: Legacy/reference field. finalizeEventPhotoV1 stores an empty string: no bearer download-token URLs are minted; clients read bytes through the authenticated Storage SDK (gcp/storage.rules).

commentCount.description: Server-owned: recounted by the onPhotoCommentCreated trigger.

sizeBytes.description: Server-owned, optional: verified object size in bytes (finalizeEventPhotoV1).

contentType.description: Server-owned, optional: verified object content type (finalizeEventPhotoV1).

status.description: pending | accepted | declined. Written only by sendInviteV1/respondToInviteV1.

requestId.description: Server-kept idempotency key of the sendInviteV1 call that created the invite.

status.description: completed: only a scheduled event that has ended. Leaving completed after the album has photos needs an admin and statusReason.

statusReason.description: Required (admin only) to reopen or cancel a completed event whose album has photos.

checkedIn.description: Optional, default true. false marks a no-show and is refused once points were awarded (ATTENDANCE_LOCKED).

changed.description: False when the stored state already matched (idempotent replay).

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Optional but expected from the portal: the `updatedAt` of the submission as listed. If the member changed the entry since, the command fails SUBMISSION_CHANGED.

replayed.description: true when the submission was already approved: nothing was awarded again (pointsAwarded is 0).

FinalizeEventPhotoRequest.description: finalizeEventPhotoV1: publish an uploaded album photo. photoId must equal '{auth.uid}_{slot}' and storagePath the matching Storage object; retries are idempotent on photoId.

created.description: false when this photoId was already finalized (idempotent retry).

AuditFieldChange.description: Short, redacted string summaries; never secrets, tokens or full documents.

AuditSummaryParam.description: One placeholder value of an audit summary. Numbers are sent as decimal strings.

AuditEntry.description: companies/{c}/auditLog/{auditId}. Append-only, written in the same transaction as the command; admin-readable only.

action.description: Dotted verb, for example member.update, photo.remove, attendee.add, import.apply.

summaryKey.description: Optional, additive. Stable message key of the summary (for example roster.invite); the admin portal renders it in the viewer's language with summaryParams. summary keeps the English text for older clients.

summaryParams.description: Optional, additive. Values for the summaryKey placeholders. Server or user content (names, titles, emails) is never translated.

EmployeeRecordInput.description: One employee row (roster entry or import row). Omitted optional fields are left unchanged on update and defaulted on create.

email.description: Work email; lower-cased server-side and matched against the company's emailDomain.

displayName.description: Hint shown until first sign-in; Google's name wins afterwards (ADR 0007).

teamIds.description: Team catalog ids or exact team names (resolved server-side).

managerEmail.description: Deprecated: accepted from older clients and files, ignored and never stored.

startDate.description: Deprecated: accepted from older clients and files, ignored and never stored.

RosterEntry.description: companies/{c}/roster/{emailHash}. Admin-readable only; server-written. Lists everyone: invited (pre-imported, not signed in yet), claimed (signed in) and revoked entries. resolveMembershipV1 claims an invited entry, or creates a claimed one, on every first join.

id.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the lower-case email.

memberPhotoURL.description: Wire-only (never stored): the claiming member's photoURL from their users document, same company only; absent when none or unclaimed.

memberAvatarId.description: Wire-only (never stored): the claiming member's avatarId; absent when empty or unclaimed.

invitedBy.description: Admin who pre-provisioned the entry; absent for entries created by the person's own sign-in.

memberStatus.description: Mirrors the member's status once claimed; kept in sync by setMemberStatusV1.

resendCount.description: How many times an admin resent the invite message.

inviteEmailCount.description: How many invitation emails DIP sent to this person (sendRosterInviteEmailV1).

revision.description: 0 when the member was never admin-edited.

target.description: update/unchanged target an existing member; create targets a roster entry (no account yet).

notices.description: Optional, informational, never blocks the row: FIELD_IGNORED (a column DIP no longer stores), TEAM_ARCHIVED, TEAM_NAME_TOO_LONG, TEAM_IMPORT_LIMIT, TEAM_COMPANY_LIMIT (the team is left out).

ImportNewTeam.description: A team an import creates (deterministic id from the normalized name).

ImportSkippedTeam.description: A team name an import leaves out; the row still imports without it.

teamsCreated.description: Optional. Teams this import created so far (absent on jobs planned before team creation).

ImportJob.description: companies/{c}/importJobs/{jobId}. Admin-readable summary and error-report data; rows and plan chunks are server-only.

newTeams.description: Optional. Teams the plan creates when their rows are applied.

RemoveEventPhotoRequest.description: removeEventPhotoV1: hard-deletes the album photo, its comments and Storage object; audit entry. album.moderate.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason recorded in the audit log.

removed.description: False when the photo was already gone.

RemoveEventPhotoCommentRequest.description: removeEventPhotoCommentV1: deletes one comment and recounts commentCount; audit entry. album.moderate.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason recorded in the audit log.

AddEventAttendeeRequest.description: addEventAttendeeV1: RSVP an active same-company member as going. attendee.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

notify.description: Default false: send an in-app notification to the member.

capacityOverrideReason.description: Required to add beyond capacity: raises the event capacity to attendeeCount + 1 and is audited.

added.description: False when the member was already going.

RemoveEventAttendeeRequest.description: removeEventAttendeeV1: cancel a member's RSVP before the event ends. attendee.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason recorded in the audit log.

removed.description: False when the member was not going.

ListMembersRequest.description: listMembersV1: searchable company member directory. member.read (points only for admins).

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of name, email, department, job title or work location.

total.description: Company members in total (first page only), for 'N of M'.

UpdateMemberRequest.description: updateMemberV1: change role, teams and org attributes. member.manage (admin). Cannot demote the last admin; displayName/points/auth ids are not editable here.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

expectedRevision.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency guard; mismatch -> aborted REVISION_CONFLICT. 0 means never admin-edited.

managerEmail.description: Deprecated: accepted from older clients, ignored and never stored.

startDate.description: Deprecated: accepted from older clients, ignored and never stored.

revision.description: Member revision after the call; 0 when the member was never admin-edited.

ResetMemberProfileRequest.description: resetMemberProfileV1: clears self-set profile data (photoURL, avatarId, city, interestTagIds, travelRadiusMiles, availability, favoritePhotoIds). Keeps identity, role, department, jobTitle, teams, location, status, points and friends. member.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason recorded in the audit log.

revision.description: Member revision after the call; 0 when the member was never admin-edited.

SetMemberStatusRequest.description: setMemberStatusV1: deactivate or reactivate. Deactivation revokes refresh tokens, cancels upcoming going RSVPs, and blocks resolveMembershipV1/rules/callables. member.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

reason.description: Optional free-text reason recorded in the audit log.

revision.description: Member revision after the call; 0 when the member was never admin-edited.

AdjustMemberPointsRequest.description: adjustMemberPointsV1: appends an admin_adjustment ledger entry and updates pointsBalance atomically. member.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

delta.description: Non-zero; the balance may not become negative.

UpsertTeamRequest.description: upsertTeamV1: create (no teamId) or rename/archive a team in the company catalog. team.manage (admin).

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

UpsertRosterEntryRequest.description: upsertRosterEntryV1: pre-provision one person who has not signed in. roster.manage (admin). An email that already belongs to a member is refused (EMAIL_ALREADY_MEMBER); use updateMemberV1.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

RevokeRosterEntryRequest.description: revokeRosterEntryV1: revoke an invited entry. roster.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

ImportEmployeesRequest.description: importEmployeesV1: validate and plan (dry run). Writes only the import job and plan chunks. import.run (admin). Max 2000 rows.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

newTeams.description: Optional. Team names that match no existing team (case and accents ignored); applying creates each once.

skippedTeams.description: Optional. Team names left out (archived, too long, over the per-import or company limit). Their rows still import.

ApplyEmployeeImportRequest.description: applyEmployeeImportV1: processes the next unprocessed chunk (<= 100 rows) of a planned job; call repeatedly until done. Resumable and idempotent. import.run.

GetEmployeeImportRequest.description: getEmployeeImportV1: job summary and error-report data. import.run.

SubmitChallengeRequest.description: submitChallengeV1: the caller's own submission {challengeId}_{uid} for the open weekly theme. Retries with the same content are idempotent; the caller is derived from Auth, never from the payload.

outcome.description: unchanged = an idempotent replay of identical content.

RejectChallengeRequest.description: rejectChallengeV1: organizer sends a pending submission back with a reason.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Optional but expected from the portal: the `updatedAt` of the submission as listed. If the member changed the entry since, the command fails SUBMISSION_CHANGED.

ListChallengeSubmissionsRequest.description: listChallengeSubmissionsV1: organizer review queue for one challenge, ordered by submission ID.

SendInviteRequest.description: sendInviteV1: invite one same-company coworker to a scheduled, future event. The invite document id is '{eventId}_{toUserId}', so a person can be invited once per event; a replay with the same requestId by the same sender returns the same invite.

created.description: false when this requestId had already created the invite (idempotent retry).

RespondToInviteRequest.description: respondToInviteV1: the recipient accepts (joins through the same capacity transaction as setRsvpV1) or declines.

rsvpStatus.description: Present when the invite was accepted.

attendeeCount.description: Present when the invite was accepted.

Coworker.description: Minimal directory entry for the invite picker: display name, avatar id and team only; never email, role, points or other profile fields.

state.description: For the event in the request.

ListCoworkersRequest.description: listCoworkersV1: search same-company members by name for the invite picker. A query of at least 2 characters is required (no company-wide enumeration); excludes the caller.

truncated.description: true when more members match than were returned; refine the query.

ResendRosterInviteRequest.description: resendRosterInviteV1: records a resend for an invited roster entry and returns the shareable message. No email is sent. roster.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

ResendRosterInviteResponse.description: Resend result: the sign-in link and a ready-to-send message for the admin to copy.

SendRosterInviteEmailRequest.description: sendRosterInviteEmailV1: emails an invitation to an invited roster entry (company name, who invited them, the sign-in link). At most 5 per entry, at least 1 hour apart. roster.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

SendRosterInviteEmailResponse.description: The invitation email is queued; it is sent within a minute unless the person signed in, opted out or the address bounces.

BackfillRosterRequest.description: backfillRosterV1: creates missing claimed roster entries for existing members, 100 members per call (cursor), never touching existing entries. dryRun only counts. roster.manage.

requestId.description: Caller-generated idempotency key (a UUID is recommended), retained across retries.

BackfillRosterResponse.description: One chunk of the backfill. `created` is what would be created when dryRun is true. Call again with nextPageToken until done.

RosterCounts.description: Roster totals by state (first page only).

ListRosterRequest.description: listRosterV1: roster page with server-side state filter and search; scans in document-id order with a cursor. roster.manage.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of name, email, department, job title or work location.

ListRosterResponse.description: A page of roster entries; keep following nextPageToken (a page can be short when filters match few of the scanned entries).

inviteEmail.description: True when DIP can email invitations for this company (email switched on for it); the portal then offers Send invite email.

AdminBugReportDiagnostics.description: Diagnostics the app attached to a bug report (all optional; shown to admins only).

AdminBugReport.description: A bug report in the admin inbox: the client-created bugReports document plus its server-owned triage state and the reporter's display name.

reporterPhotoURL.description: The reporter's stored Google photo base URL; absent when none.

reporterAvatarId.description: The reporter's stored avatar id; absent when empty.

AdminBugReportCounts.description: Report totals by triage status over the newest reports (first page only); `capped` is true when older reports were not counted.

ListBugReportsRequest.description: listBugReportsV1: newest-first page of the company's bug reports with filters and a cursor. bugreport.manage (admin only).

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of description, reporter name, screen, app version or report id.

ListBugReportsResponse.description: A page of bug reports, newest first; keep following nextPageToken (a page can be short when filters match few of the scanned reports).

GetBugReportRequest.description: getBugReportV1: full detail of one report. bugreport.manage.

GetBugReportResponse.description: One report with reporter email, the diagnostics the app included, triage state and a 15 minute screenshot URL.

screenshotUrl.description: Signed read URL (15 minutes), or a data: URL when signing is unavailable. Absent without a screenshot.

UpdateBugReportRequest.description: updateBugReportV1: set the triage status, internal note or assignee of a report (stored in companies/{c}/bugReportTriage/{reportId}). Needs at least one of status, note, assigneeId (null clears). bugreport.manage; idempotent per requestId.

UpdateBugReportResponse.description: Triage state after the update; changed is false when nothing differed.

GetCompanyInsightsRequest.description: getCompanyInsightsV1: how the company uses DIP. insights.read (organizer, admin); points and member balances are admin only. Read-only, no requestId.

refresh.description: Ask for fresh numbers; honored at most once a minute, otherwise the cached summary (max 10 minutes old) is returned.

photoURL.description: The member's stored Google photo base URL; absent when none.

avatarId.description: The member's stored avatar id; absent when empty (the app then generates one from the user id).

pendingReviews.description: Submissions waiting for review in this theme.

invited.description: Roster entries that have not signed in yet.

activeLast30Days.description: Distinct members with an RSVP in the window (a lower bound when activeCapped).

thisMonth.description: Events starting this UTC month, any status.

attendanceRate.description: Checked in / going over the latest completed events; null without a sample.

pendingReviews.description: Waiting across the recent weekly themes.

GetCompanyInsightsResponse.description: points is present for admins only; challenges.current is absent without an active weekly theme.

generatedAt.description: When the numbers were computed (cached up to 10 minutes).

activity.description: Oldest first, the last 30 UTC days including today.

unavailable.description: Sections whose queries failed this time. Each listed section still has its required shape but holds zeros and must be shown as unavailable, not as real numbers. Absent or empty when every section was computed.

AiInterestTag.description: One common interest in the caller's company, as a rounded bucket (never an exact count).

bucket.description: Rounded member count; tags with fewer than 5 interested members are never counted (small-cell suppression).

AiIdeaTheme.description: The company's current weekly theme, when one is running.

AiCreditCosts.description: Credits each tool costs per use.

coverPick.description: Credits for one "Let Dipbot choose" cover pick (pickEventCoverV1); charged only when a model answered.

venueSearch.description: Credits for one Dipbot venue search (findVenuesV1); free when served from the 24 h cache or when no model answered.

ideas.description: Credits for one Dipbot daily ideas run (getDipbotIdeasV1); charged only when the ideas model answered. Optional for older servers.

themeSuggest.description: Credits for one Dipbot theme suggestion (suggestThemeV1); charged only when a model suggestion survived validation. Optional for older servers.

AiCredits.description: Dipbot credits: the only unit admins see for AI use. Credits are a fixed per-tool price, never a currency amount. They reset at the start of the calendar month in the company's time zone.

creditsAllowance.description: This month's allowance for the company.

resetsAt.description: When the allowance resets (start of the next calendar month in the company's time zone).

generationsRemaining.description: What the caller can still run now: the smallest of the monthly, daily and budget headroom.

GetEventIdeaContextRequest.description: getEventIdeaContextV1: what the AI idea flow starts from. ai.generate (admin). Read-only, no requestId.

enabled.description: False when AI drafts are switched off for the deployment or this company; the rest is still returned.

interestDataAvailable.description: False until per-company interest counts exist.

thinInterestTagIds.description: Catalog tags with fewer than 5 interested members (no counts).

themeSuggestEnabled.description: True when Suggest theme (suggestThemeV1) is available for this company: AI on for the company, AI_THEME_SUGGEST_ENABLED not false and aiSettings.themeSuggestEnabled not false. Absent from older servers (treat as false).

GetEventIdeaSuggestionsRequest.description: getEventIdeaSuggestionsV1: per-step suggestions and ranked considerations for the AI idea flow. ai.generate (admin). The answer is saved once per company (companies/{c}/aiCache/suggestions) and shared by every admin: a visit with a valid cache costs 0 credits and makes no model call. A model call (1 credit) runs only for the first-ever visit, or when `refresh` is true.

sessionId.description: Legacy per-visit UUID; accepted as the requestId when no requestId is sent.

requestId.description: Idempotency key of one refresh press: a repeated request is never charged twice.

refresh.description: true recomputes the saved suggestions (1 credit, only when a model answers). Needs a requestId or sessionId.

AiStepSuggestion.description: The option the decision model ranks first for one choice of the flow. A hint only: the portal never selects it without the admin.

value.description: A catalog tag id for interest, otherwise the AiEventChoices enum value of that field.

probability.description: Probability that this option is the best fit. Jev answers are calibrated; the portal caps the label for the other providers.

reason.description: One line built by the server from rounded interest buckets and past-event counts (never model text).

reasonBasis.description: company_data: the company's own data (above the privacy floor) drove this suggestion; generic: a general default, so the reason never implies personalization.

AiConsiderationRank.description: Relevance of one consideration chip (catalog id) for this company, best first. A hint for what to surface first; every consideration stays reachable.

provider.description: Who answered: TypeSafe AI Jev, the OpenAI mini fallback, the deterministic heuristic, or none (no interest data and no past events).

cached.description: true unless this call computed the answer (cacheStatus computed).

cacheStatus.description: fresh: saved answer, inputs unchanged. stale: saved answer shown as is (inputs changed or older than the max age); nothing was recomputed. computed: this call ran the decision chain (or the free heuristic).

computedAt.description: When the saved answer was computed.

staleReason.description: Why a stale answer is stale: the company data changed materially, or it is older than the max age.

creditsCharged.description: Credits this call charged (0 for every cached load).

considerations.description: Every consideration chip, most relevant first.

GetDipbotIdeasRequest.description: getDipbotIdeasV1: the company's daily Dipbot ideas (4 to 6 event ideas proposed from scratch by a tool-using model over the company's own aggregates). ai.generate (admin). load never calls a model; auto refreshes at most once per company per day and only when the inputs changed materially; refresh is the explicit button (charged, idempotent per requestId, limited per day).

mode.description: load: stored ideas or the free fallback, never a model call. auto: the lazy daily refresh the portal starts when load says autoRefreshDue. refresh: the Refresh ideas button.

requestId.description: Idempotency key of one refresh press (required for refresh).

DipbotIdea.description: One idea card. Text is model-written but validated server-side: tags are catalog ids, the why line quotes only numbers present in the tool results, the date avoids the company's busy days.

why.description: One grounded line on why this fits the company.

reasonBasis.description: company_data only when the line is grounded in the company's own aggregates; generic wording otherwise.

fitLabel.description: Perfect fit, Great choice or Good match. Absent when no label is earned (never a percentage).

startsAt.description: Suggested start within the next 4 weeks, on a day without a conflicting event when possible.

source.description: agent: written by the ideas model. catalog: the free deterministic fallback from the curated catalog.

enabled.description: false when AI ideas are off (AI_IDEAS_ENABLED, AI events off, or aiSettings.ideasEnabled false); the portal hides the section.

status.description: fresh or stale: stored ideas (stale = older than the max age); computed: this call ran the model; fallback: the free catalog ideas, nothing stored.

generatedAt.description: When the stored ideas were generated by the model.

dataLevel.description: How much company activity the ideas could use; none shows the starter-ideas copy.

autoRefreshDue.description: load only: true when the portal should start one auto refresh in the background (stale and inputs changed, or nothing stored yet), credits and budget allowing.

refreshesLeftToday.description: Manual refreshes left for the company today.

outcome.description: auto or refresh: updated (new ideas), unchanged (same requestId replay), extended (inputs unchanged, freshness extended for free), skipped (not due, busy, no credits or budget), failed (no model answer; nothing charged).

AiEventChoices.description: The card answers of the idea flow; every value is an enum.

GenerateEventDraftsRequest.description: generateEventDraftsV1: AI event drafts for review. ai.generate (admin). Writes no events; a retry with the same requestId returns the stored drafts.

prompt.description: The admin's own words; treated as untrusted data. May be empty.

considerations.description: Chosen consideration ids from the fixed catalog (accessibility, dietary, vibe, logistics, inclusion, safety). Unknown ids are rejected.

GeneratedEventDraft.description: An AI suggestion shaped like EventDraft, without a venue or exact times (the admin picks those in the event form).

coverImageURL.description: Always an approved cover accepted by createEventV1: a legacy catalog://default/<category> image or a catalog://cover/<key> image from the hosted cover library (the key must exist in the library manifest).

venueSearchHint.description: Words to search venues with; never a specific venue.

rationale.description: One line on why this fits the company.

replay.description: True when the stored result of an earlier call with this requestId was returned.

PickEventCoverRequest.description: pickEventCoverV1: Dipbot chooses the best cover from the cover library for an event. ai.generate (admin). Writes no events; the answering provider is logged on a content-free request document.

description.description: Event description; only the first 600 characters are used. Treated as untrusted data.

theme.description: Optional explicit weekly theme; otherwise derived from tagIds.

excludeCoverImageURLs.description: Covers already used by other drafts, avoided when possible.

source.description: dipbot: the AI decision chose it; match: the deterministic text match chose it; default: nothing matched, so the theme default.

provider.description: Which decision provider answered (jev, openai or heuristic), or null when none was consulted.

alternatives.description: Other good covers from the shortlist, best first.

newPhoto.description: true when Dipbot pulled a fresh photo for this pick; informational. Absent otherwise.

coverAlt.description: Alt text of the chosen cover when it is a stored live photo (catalog://cover/pixabay-<id>); absent for library covers.

CoverSearchStatus.description: Outcome of searchCoverPhotosV1: ok; rate_limited (Pixabay or the per-instance limiter); quota (daily live caps reached); unavailable (Pixabay failed).

CoverPhotoCandidate.description: One Pixabay photo offered for import. previewURL is a temporary (24 hour) Pixabay rendition that may only be displayed in the search results, never stored or hotlinked permanently.

stored.description: true when the photo is already in the stored dynamic library (importing it needs no download).

SearchCoverPhotosRequest.description: searchCoverPhotosV1: an admin searches Pixabay for more cover photos. ai.generate (admin); free (no credits); counts against the live daily quotas only on a cache miss. The text is treated as a title and stripped of personal data before it leaves the server.

ImportCoverPhotoRequest.description: importCoverPhotoV1: stores a photo from a recent search as a dynamic cover. The client sends only the key; the server fetches only a photo it remembered from a search within 24 hours (COVER_CANDIDATE_EXPIRED otherwise). ai.generate (admin); free.

newPhoto.description: true when this call stored a fresh photo; false when an existing stored cover was reused.

SuggestionsEmailAction.description: What manageSuggestionsEmailV1 does: read status, render a dry-run preview, queue a test email to the caller, turn the caller's own email preference on or off, or set the company schedule.

SuggestionsEmailSchedule.description: When the weekly ideas email goes out, in the company time zone: weekday 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday) and hour 0 to 23.

ManageSuggestionsEmailRequest.description: manageSuggestionsEmailV1: the admin's weekly ideas email. ai.generate (admin). preview renders without sending.

SuggestionsEmailPreview.description: A server-rendered dry run of this week's email; nothing is sent.

engine.description: Which ranking engine produced the ideas.

dataLevel.description: How much company activity the ranking could use.

emailEnabled.description: False when email is switched off for the deployment or this company.

aiEnabled.description: False when AI events are switched off; ideas then come from the heuristic engine.

timeZone.description: IANA company time zone the schedule is read in.

nextSendAt.description: Next scheduled send, or null when sending is off.

testQueued.description: sendTest only: true when a test email was queued.

testReason.description: sendTest only: why no test email was queued.

ResolveSuggestedIdeaRequest.description: resolveSuggestedIdeaV1: turns the signed link of a weekly ideas email into an event draft. ai.generate (admin). Read-only.

CompanyOffice.description: The company's office location, the center of Dipbot venue searches.

locality.description: City or area; stored as Company.city.

SetCompanyOfficeRequest.description: setCompanyOfficeV1: sets the office location used as the center of Dipbot venue searches. company.manage (admin). The server resolves the picked place (Place Details) and stores the address, city, coordinates and place ID; it rejects 0/0.

placeId.description: Google Places place ID (storable indefinitely under the Google Maps Platform terms).

FindVenuesRequest.description: findVenuesV1: Dipbot venue finder. Searches places of interest around the company office for the event and ranks the top options. ai.generate (admin). Writes no events. Only place categories, the office coordinates and the radius reach the places provider; event text reaches only the decision provider.

radiusMiles.description: Search radius around the office; default 5.

VenueOption.description: One venue Dipbot suggests. Every field comes from the places provider or from server rules over it; nothing is invented (no ratings, hours or prices).

id.description: Opaque option id, unique within the response.

kind.description: Venue kind from the provider's category; the portal shows its label.

distanceMiles.description: Straight-line distance from the office, one decimal.

website.description: Always null for now: websites are an Enterprise-tier Places field we do not request.

reasons.description: Grounded reasons, best first: theme_match (the kind matches the event), outdoor_fit / indoor_fit (setting matches the outdoor flag), close (within 1 mile), group_fit (kind suits the group size).

placeId.description: Google Places place ID (storable indefinitely under the Google Maps Platform terms).

venues.description: Best first; empty when nothing matched in the radius.

provider.description: Which decision provider ranked the venues, or null when none was consulted.

cached.description: true when served from the company's 24 h cache (not charged).

charged.description: true when this search spent a credit.

PlaceSuggestion.description: One typeahead suggestion (Google Places Autocomplete). Shown only, never stored.

placeId.description: Google Places place ID (storable indefinitely under the Google Maps Platform terms).

isPlace.description: true for a named place (establishment), false for a street address or area.

AutocompletePlacesRequest.description: autocompletePlacesV1: address and place typeahead for the event editor and the office setting. event.manage (organizer, admin). Biased to the company office when set. Free to admins; capped per company per day. Only the typed text, the session token and the office bias reach Google.

ResolvedPlace.description: A place resolved on the server (Place Details): fills the Where fields. Coordinates are kept hidden in the editor and saved with the event together with the place ID.

placeId.description: Google Places place ID (storable indefinitely under the Google Maps Platform terms).

name.description: Place name for establishments; null for a plain street address.

kind.description: Venue kind from the provider's category; the portal shows its label.

ResolvePlaceRequest.description: resolvePlaceV1: resolves a picked suggestion (placeId, ending the autocomplete session) or geocodes a typed address (query) before saving. event.manage (organizer, admin). Same daily cap as autocompletePlacesV1.

placeId.description: Google Places place ID (storable indefinitely under the Google Maps Platform terms).

query.description: Typed street address plus city, when no suggestion was picked.

place.description: Absent when nothing matched the query.

SuggestThemeRequest.description: suggestThemeV1: Dipbot suggests a weekly theme for the New theme form (title, description, tags, a free week and an illustration) from the company's own aggregates, past themes and past events. ai.generate (admin); the tenant comes from the server membership and companyId must equal it. Idempotent per requestId.

requestId.description: Idempotency key of one press. A replay returns the stored answer and is never charged twice.

hint.description: Optional words from the admin ("something calm for exam season"). Moderated; links, emails and phone numbers are refused (AI_PROMPT_REJECTED).

fields.description: Which form fields the admin wants filled; informs the prompt only. Every suggestion still carries title, description, tags and illustration. Default: all.

locale.description: Language for the model-written text (default en). Catalog fallback suggestions stay English.

ThemeSuggestion.description: One suggested weekly theme, validated and repaired on the server: catalog tag ids only, title and description within the theme limits, no repeat of a recent or scheduled theme, why lines quoting only numbers that appear in the tool results.

description.description: What members do and post during the week.

weekStart.description: Monday (civil date, America/New_York weeks like the portal) of a free week in the next 12 weeks; absent when none is free.

fitLabel.description: Shown as Perfect fit, Great choice or Good match; absent without company data or for a weak match.

alternatives.description: 2 to 3 more themes for Another idea (fewer only when the catalog runs out).

outcome.description: suggested: at least one model suggestion survived (charged); fallback: catalog suggestions only (free).
